name: NebuSec
long_description:
NebuSec is founded by the world’s #1 hacking team.

We were the first team to build an nginx RCE and the first to root Android 17. Our co-founders include members of the world’s No. 1 CTF team, DEF CON winners, Black Hat speakers, and PhD in cybersecurity. We have won $400K in bug bounties by exploiting the Linux kernel and Chrome browser.

“Audited by NebuSec” is a mark of serious security credibility: a signal to customers, investors, and partners that your product has been reviewed by the world’s best hackers.

founders.title: Founder/COO
founders.founder_bio: Founder of Nebula Security (YC S26). Black Hat USA speaker and DEF CON finalist with r3kapig, the world's No. 1 hacking team in 2025. He led the DARPA AIxCC automated program repair team and shipped end-to-end RCE/LPE exploit chains on Chrome, Firefox, Linux, and Android. He pwned Google's kernelCTF multiple times with zero-days, and has published research at top academic venues such as USENIX Security and NDSS. Ph.D. dropout.

founders.title: Founder/VP of Vulnerability Research
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Nebula Security (YC S26). Hacked into iPhone, Chrome, Firefox, Safari, QEMU, and various things in your daily life. DEFCON finalist for 3 consecutive years. $200k+ Bug Bounty in Chrome. Core member of r3kapig, the #1 hacking team in the world in 2025, on CTFTime. M.S. from UC San Diego. Research published at USENIX Security, BlackHat USA. Ph.D. droped out.

launches.title: Nebula Security: Bringing beyond Mythos protection to your product
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** AI has changed cybersecurity. Don't let the next HuggingFace incident happen to your product. Hire VEGA, your best security engineer — a cybersecurity agent built by the world's best hacking team. It brings the same capabilities used to uncover critical vulnerabilities in browsers, operating systems, and internet infrastructure to protect your product. [Book a demo](https://nebula-security.cal.com/etenz/30min?overlayCalendar=true) today or find us at <http://nebusec.ai>

**The Problem:** Cybersecurity has changed. When the attackers have AI, how do you prevent the next HuggingFace incident from happening to your product?

We are here at Nebula Security for one reason, we are building the **world’s best cybersecurity agent**, bringing beyond Mythos protection to your product. 

### AI makes you fast. We make you secure

Introducing **VEGA**, the best cybersecurity agent that is built by the world's best hackers. An agent that has discovered critical vulnerabilities in major infrastructure and earned over **$400K** in rewards from Google.

Watch our [launch video](https://youtu.be/gOzg5M5DhXI)

With VEGA, you can:

* Autonomously find bugs in your codebase
* Monitor code changes 24/7
* Analyze root causes and generate Proofs of Concept
* Provide ready-to-use patches
* Understand the overall code health

You focus on bringing your product to the world. We manage the security.

# The world saw the proof

While ~~other companies~~ create hypes, we show you the proof.

VEGA discovered

* [IonStack](https://x.com/nebusecurity/status/2069707520160227688?s=20): the world's first fullchain exploit to root Android 17.
* [GhostLock](https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/15-year-old-ghostlock-flaw-enables-root.html): a 15-year-old Linux kernel vulnerability capable of compromising nearly all the Linux devices in the world.
* [nginx-poolslip](https://x.com/nebusecurity/status/2057071579876753643?s=20) and nginx-quicburst: the world's first and second vulnerabilities capable of remotely control your Nginx servers
* And 91 more CVEs from Linux, Windows, Chrome Browser, Firefox, Nginx, Wordpress, and the other software you use every day.

We found vulnerabilities in the world's most complex software. Let us protect your product too.

# The epic hacker team

* Eten (CEO): PhD in Cybersecurity; Pwn2Own winner; speaker at Linux Security Summit, Off-by-One, IEEE S&P, USENIX Security, and NDSS. Previously worked at Microsoft.
* Yuan (CTO): Previous cybersecurity PhD; Black hat speaker; Bringing VEGA to secure Linux Kernel.
* Xiaochuan (Research Lead): From the world's #1 hacking team; three-time DEFCON participant; Jailbreak iPhone; Black Hat speaker; Previously worked at Zellic.
* Frank (Research Lead): From the world’s #1 hacking team; DEFCON participant; Black hat speaker. Built the world’s first Android 17 root exploit.

We have won over **$400,000** from Google by breaking into their safest system.

Let us show you what we can find in your system. [Book a demo](https://nebula-security.cal.com/etenz/30min?overlayCalendar=true) today.

Find us at <http://nebusec.ai> | Email to [founders@nebusec.ai](mailto:founders@nebusec.ai)
